recall_additions.name: Monzo
recall_additions.basis: YC Continuity led Monzo's GBP 113M Series F at a GBP 2B post-money, June 2019; Monzo is not a YC batch alumnus, so the directory structurally cannot list it (decisions.md D2). The base build had dropped it as a Form D-only Commercial Banking row — correct as a general rule, wrong for a Continuity holding.

recall_additions.name: Convoy
recall_additions.basis: YC Continuity led Convoy's $62M Series B, July 2017 — reported at the time as the fund's first investment in a non-alumni company. Distinct from the directory's 'Convoy' (Winter 2022 batch); this is the Seattle digital-freight company that wound down October 2023.
